title: Attack on Titan Is Coming Back?! WIT Studio Teases a New Project!
summary:
Did you think Attack on Titan was over? Think again! The studio that made the first half of the anime, WIT Studio, just dropped a mysterious teaser. They say they have an Attack on Titan announcement coming on August 20. The post reads, "It seems that they, during 'that period,' will be holding a special dinner." What does that mean? Nobody knows for sure, but it's got fans super excited.

The teaser image shows Eren, Armin, Mikasa, Levi, Hange, and Erwin—all the main characters. But here's the weird part: the anime already ended in 2023, and it covered the whole manga story. So what could this new project be? Maybe a prequel? A movie? A game? The post mentions a "special dinner," which is a creepy reference because the series has a lot of cannibalism. Yikes!

WIT Studio hasn't worked on Attack on Titan since 2019. After that, MAPPA took over. So it's surprising that WIT is the one making the announcement. But last year, a producer said they planned to keep making Attack on Titan things like movies and concerts. So maybe this is one of those.

We'll have to wait until next Thursday to find out. Until then, let the theories fly!
why_it_matters: Even when a story you love seems finished, creators can bring it back in new forms, and waiting for official news can teach you to enjoy surprises without believing every theory.

background_read: Attack on Titan began as a manga by Hajime Isayama and became one of the most famous anime series in the world.
WIT Studio and MAPPA are Japanese animation studios that worked on different parts of the show; WIT handled the earlier seasons, and MAPPA took over after 2019.
When a popular series ends, studios sometimes announce movies, spin-offs, or special events to keep the story alive for fans.
Article_Structure: WHO: WIT Studio, the animation studio that made the first half of Attack on Titan.
WHAT: It posted a mysterious teaser for an Attack on Titan announcement coming on August 20.
WHERE: In an online post that shows main characters and mentions a special dinner.
WHY: Fans are excited because the anime ended in 2023, so any new movie, prequel, or game would be unexpected.
